responsibility: Implements target-specific builtin support for rs6000 instructions and CPU/runtime queries. It owns builtin type initialization support state, target-option gating and diagnostics for generated builtin IDs, early folding hooks, expansion of builtin calls into RTL patterns or special helper sequences (including vector loads/stores, MMA, HTM, and cpu_supports-style probes), and the glue between generated builtin tables and actual instruction emission in the backend.
